name: Margadeepam Scholarship
benefit:
> ***Financial Assistance***

- Scholarship amount of ₹1,500/- per student per academic year.
- One-time Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in the name of selected students.

> ***Conditions***

- The beneficiary must maintain an active Aadhaar-linked bank account with a nationalized or scheduled bank in their own name for Direct Benefit Transfer.
- The beneficiary must
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala. - The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th. - The applicant must be studying in a Government or Government-aided school. - The applicant must belong to a minority religious community (Hindu, Christian (all denominations), Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi). - The applicant's family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. _*If adequate applicants are not available in one category, students from other categories may be considered._ ##### **Earmarking** - 30% scholarships are reserved for female students. - The applicant (male students) may be considered for female-reserved positions if adequate female applications are not received. ##### ***Additional Merit Consideration*** - **PwD:** The applicant should provide disability certificate if having 40% and above physical/mental disability.- **Orphan:** The applicant should provide death certificate if orphaned (father/mother/both parents deceased). ##### ***Merit Point Calculation System*** Family Income: Formula = (2,50,000 - Actual Income)/25,000 (Maximum 10 points). Academic Grades: Maximum 12 points (A+ Grade = 12, A Grade = 11, B+ Grade = 10, B Grade = 9, C+ Grade = 8, C Grade = 7, D+ Grade = 6, D Grade = 5). Orphaned Students: 4 points maximum (Both parents deceased = 4, Single parent deceased = 2). Physical/Mental Disability: 4 points (40% and above disability and category 2 disability). Total Maximum Points: 30. _*Academic excellence for Class 2nd to Class 8th students will be determined based on grade points received in academic year._ _*Class 1st students will not be evaluated on academic marks but on income eligibility criteria._ ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must reapply fresh each academic year to continue receiving benefits. - The applicant must maintain eligibility criteria throughout the benefit period. - The applicant must not provide false declarations as it will result in immediate scholarship cancellation and recovery of disbursed amount.
